sourceRefs.title: Microsoft Learn: Create number series
sourceRefs.claim: Default Nos. allows automatic numbering; Manual Nos. allows manual number entry.

actionsTaken: Opened Business Central Number Series Page 456 in playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
Selected the U-VEND row before checkbox diagnosis.
Enabled Liste bearbeiten / Edit List before checkbox write.
Mapped U-VEND row and checkbox header positions before any write.
Attempted only U-VEND Standardnr. / Default Nos.; no other series or lines were changed.
actionsNotTaken: No non-U-VEND number series was changed.
No vendor, customer or item was created.
No document or draft was created.
Manual Nos. / Manuelle Anz. was inspected but not changed.
proved: Business Central stayed in playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
U-VEND Number Series checkbox route was attempted.
notProved: No vendor is created by this case.
No manual U-VEND-100 number route is proven.
No Vendor Posting Group, VAT group, payment term, document, Preview Posting or Posting is proven.
No number-series line, last number used or compliance behavior is changed/proven by this checkbox fit.
blockedBy: U-VEND Standardnr. / Default Nos. did not persist after the visible row-scoped click route.
warnings: This case only unblocks automatic vendor numbering; it does not make the vendor posting-ready.
Manual Nos. remains a separate decision if the book requires explicit U-VEND-100 style numbers.
